artifact_io.reason: Novel Writing persists canonical project/checkpoint state, Canon/prose/review artifacts, publication facts and migration references whose identity, freshness, invalidation and retention are governed explicitly.

operational_hygiene.reason: The owner has release hard gates, reminder-dependency repair, incident/review evidence, stale-dependent-hash handling and periodic regression before release/promotion.

evolution.reason: The owner performs durable system learning from user feedback, accepted/rejected review evidence and reader/platform evidence, with independent review/regression before promotion.

hook_bindings.observability_or_incident_evidence_locat: hash-bound project reviews/acceptance/checkpoints plus CHANGELOG.md and exact incident evidence referenced by the active project
hook_bindings.self_maintenance_trigger_path: SKILL.md release-hard-gate reminder-dependency rule: when the user identifies a defect the system should have caught, revoke stale release evidence, repair, re-audit and upgrade the general defense
hook_bindings.garbage_collection_owner_and_dependency_: continuity/ARTIFACT_CONTEXT_GOVERNANCE.json#superseded_artifact_cleanup_rule with published FINAL/Canon retention and dependency checks
hook_bindings.reliability_or_change_freeze_guard: SKILL.md release hard gates plus periodic regression: no Canon/release promotion on failed quality evidence, stale dependent hashes, or unresolved BLOCKER/HIGH findings
hook_bindings.learning_evidence_location: project user feedback, post-publication performance evidence, rejected/accepted review evidence and system-level rule evidence referenced by the owner project
hook_bindings.eval_or_regression_promotion_path: SKILL.md release hard gates + periodic regression; system learning is promoted only after relevant independent review/regression evidence and must not overwrite project facts
hook_bindings.superseded_mechanism_cleanup_rule: continuity/ARTIFACT_CONTEXT_GOVERNANCE.json#superseded_artifact_cleanup_rule; old Library/Notion/Drive executable material remains retired and cannot regain authority by presence

overrides.evaluator_selection: Novel evolution is judged through chapter/project-specific independent review, identity regression, periodic long-form/Canon checks and real reader/platform evidence when available

methodology_assurance.boundary: Repository declaration, applicability evidence and owner regression do not prove a live chapter methodology profile executed; action-level profile activation remains evidence-gated and this binding does not modify Canon, prose, publication facts, task stage or writer lease.
